candidates.change_summary: Remove the `|| super.supportsInterface(interfaceId)` so it no longer delegates to ERC165, causing it to return false for the IERC165 interfaceId.
Return false unconditionally instead of looking up the member mapping.
Return true unconditionally instead of looking up the member mapping.
Negate the membership check so the return value is flipped.
Return a constant bytes32 zero instead of the actual admin role.
Return the input 'role' itself instead of its admin role.
Return DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE (0x00) instead of the actual admin role.
Remove the require check for account == _msgSender() so anyone can renounce a role for any account.
Reverse the require condition to disallow renouncing own roles but allow renouncing for others.
Delete the require statement entirely, allowing any caller to renounce any role for any account.
Change _revokeRole to _grantRole, turning renounce into a role grant operation.
Swap arguments to _revokeRole so that the role and account are reversed.
